[[File:42_Dioxis.png|thumb|right|250px|Dioxis gas released onboard the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] over [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].]]
{{Quote|Dioxis! Breathe it, and you're dead!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>}}
'''Dioxis''' was a potent toxic gas used by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] at the time of and following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. The green-white gas was deadly to most carbon-based lifeforms.

[[File:TournamentOnSerenno-TB.png|thumb|left|220px|Dioxis fills The Box during the Tournament on Serenno]]

When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] to negotiate the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends#The Blockade of Naboo|blockade of Naboo]], the ambassadors were double-crossed by [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. The Neimoidians released dioxis gas via gas emitters into the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']]{{'s}} conference room where the Jedi waited. However, their command of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] afforded them a sense of the danger, and were able to [[Breath control|survive in the toxic environment]] until a squad of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security battle droids]] arrived with orders to dispose of their bodies.

Thirteen years later, on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], Obi-Wan Kenobi identified a toxic gas released by Nute Gunray's [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]] as dioxis&mdash;though this toxin was also identified as [[swamp gas]], the chemical weapon used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] earlier in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], dioxis was used as part of a [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|contest]] arranged by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Within a construct known as [[Box/Legends|The Box]], eleven bounty hunters competed in a series of tasks to prove their worthiness to be part of a team that would abduct [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The first task involved the competitors having to escape a room that was filling with dioxis gas.<ref name="The Box" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dioxis first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].

For the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[The Box]]," it was originally intended to fill the chamber of the first challenge at the [[Box/Legends|Box]] with [[Water/Legends|water]] instead of Dioxis. According to supervising director [[Dave Filoni]], however, when they wrote the story, they had yet to solve water, leading the production crew to drop the water in favor of Dioxis. Though they eventually solved for water, the constrained FX budget for the episode necessitated sticking with Dioxis.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-box-trivia-gallery|text="The Box" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref>
